title: Fast Kikuchi Spheres for Forward Model EBSD Indexing
content: Forward model indexing approaches for electron backscatter diffraction (EBSD) compare experimental patterns to simulated data instead of the inverse approaches used by traditional Hough based indexing [1]. Once a simulation of the Kikuchi sphere is available GPU implementations of these approaches can index thousands of patterns per second providing robust noise tolerance and superior precision. Kikuchi spheres have typically been derived from computationally intensive dynamical diffraction simulations that require detailed knowledge of the crystal structure [2]. Simulations for small volume, high symmetry unit cells can be performed in a few minutes while large, low symmetry structures may require days or weeks.
